name: Amy Griffin
description: International historical mapping researcher featured at New Zealand GeoCart conferences.
story: Cartographies of change: GeoCart 2018 proceedings, National Library of New Zealand record 40158196 lists Amy Griffin as an author of “Mapping refugee journeys during the Vietnam War”.

The 2014 GeoCart accepted abstract identifies Griffin, Bob Hall and Andrew Ross with the University of New South Wales for a place-based Vietnam War webmap. The 2018 GeoCart proceedings list her with Vy Nguyen and Bob Hall on refugee-journey mapping during the Vietnam War. These demonstrate an international historical-geovisualisation contribution at conferences held in New Zealand. They do not establish a New Zealand employer or local mapping implementation.
